packageRules.description: The examples teach sluiceway/sluiceway@v0, the moving tag that the action's README tells a new user to copy. Renovate leaves it as it is: no digest pin and no update. A real repo may pin a commit instead, as the action's README says under 'Pin a commit'.

The npm workspaces at the repo root, for pulumi/monorepo: one pull request for all of their updates, never merged on its own. The check on a pull request runs no preview, so only the scan after the merge shows whether the programs still run. Read the diff and merge by hand.

Pulumi runs the TypeScript programs through ts-node, which works with TypeScript 5. TypeScript 6 stops at the tsconfig option moduleResolution node (TS5107), and TypeScript 7 does not load in ts-node at all, so either one fails every preview.
The types of Node follow the major version in .nvmrc.
